title: Thanks, Tony, and thanks, Rabbi Edelheit
excerpt: A beautiful Passover story here: http://www.patheos.com/blogs/tonyjones/2013/03/28/a-tomato-on-the-seder-plate/ May our Easter celebrations tomorrow move us deeper into the unending Easter uprising – of justice, peace, compassion, service, and love.
